Description
If you are looking for the most convenient and preferred way to invest in Silver, then investing your money in the 100 oz Valcambi Silver Bar is the most suitable way to secure your future. The 100 Oz Valcambi Silver Bar is now available at a low premium for purchase at Bullion Trading LLC.
Located in Switerzland, the Valcambi Sussie Mint was established in 1961 by Valori and Cambi. Since it started manufacturing precious metals, Valcambi has been known for its fine craftsmanship and high-quality products. The gold and silver bars from the Valcambi Sussie are known for their excellent value among investors and collectors. The 100 Oz Valcambi Silver bar with .999 purity is a fine example of the perfection and precision of this refinery to your collection.
Design of 100 oz Valcambi Silver Bar
The obverse of the bar features the name and logo of Valcambi Sussie on the top of the bar. The bottom half of the bar has the “100 Ounces Silver” and “999,0” texts engraved. It also includes the weight, purity, and mark of the assayer.
The bar’s reverse is left blank and smooth by the mint purposefully for easy storage. The 100 oz Valcambi Silver is cast and poured into a mold to create its shape and design, so each silver bar has unique striations and texture.
Main Highlights of 100 oz Valcambi Silver Bar
The 100 oz bar contains .999 fine Silver
Observe has weight, purity, and metal content engraved
The reverse of the bar is blank, i.e., it doesn’t have any design or carving
Eligible for precious metal IRA
The bar is sealed in a protective plastic wrapping
